standard_prerequisites.name: The lifting statement for a class of modules closed under the relevant operations applies once five properties hold: closure under projectivity, closure under summands, surjectivity modulo the ideal, lifting of projectives from the quotient and boundedness of the object
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the criterion that is then verified property by property for the class of all projective modules.

standard_prerequisites.name: Nakayama's lemma gives that a map of projective modules which is surjective modulo the ideal is surjective
standard_prerequisites.use: Establishes one of the five properties for the class of projectives.

standard_prerequisites.name: Every projective module over the quotient lifts to a projective module over the ring, and boundedness of an object can be checked modulo a nilpotent ideal
standard_prerequisites.use: Establishes the remaining two properties and hence the conclusion.

core_obligations: Apply the lifting statement for a class of modules, taking for the class all projective modules over the ring, and announce that its five properties will be verified (proof lines 19483-19485).
Verify the first two properties immediately: the class consists of projective modules and is closed under direct summands (proof lines 19485-19486).

Verify the third property using Nakayama's lemma, which says that a map of projectives surjective modulo the ideal is surjective, and the fourth property using the lifting of projective modules from the quotient by the ideal (proof lines 19486-19490).

Verify the last property: since the fibre of the object modulo the ideal is represented by a bounded above complex, the object itself lies in the bounded below derived category by the boundedness statement modulo a nilpotent ideal, which gives the required boundedness and hence the existence of the lifting complex with the stated reduction (proof lines 19490-19494).
proof_roadmap: Invoke the abstract lifting statement with the class of all projectives (proof lines 19483-19485).
Check the five properties: the first two immediately, the third by Nakayama, the fourth by lifting projectives, the fifth by boundedness modulo the nilpotent ideal (proof lines 19485-19494).
Read off the existence of the lifted complex together with its reduction (proof lines 19485-19494).
difficulty_reason: The statement says that for a nilpotent ideal, a bounded above complex of projective modules over the quotient representing the fibre of an object of the derived category lifts to a bounded above complex of projective modules over the ring representing the object, with the reduction of the lift isomorphic to the given complex (statement lines 19468-19481). The proof is an application of the abstract lifting statement for a class of modules, in which the class of all projective modules is shown to satisfy the five required properties: projectivity and closure under summands are immediate, surjectivity modulo the ideal follows from Nakayama's lemma, lifting of projectives from the quotient is a standard algebra statement, and boundedness of the object follows from the boundedness statement modulo a nilpotent ideal (proof lines 19483-19494). The verification of the five properties is the content of the proof; the last one is where nilpotence of the ideal enters. The counted span refers four times, once to a result of this chapter used as the criterion and once to another of this chapter for boundedness, plus two to results of other chapters, all carried as navigation stubs.
